name: The Clown
source:
Play as an unnamed female narrator as you suddenly wake up in a dark room, and move around to find yourself in a circus theater where you will witness probably one of the most disturbing things in your life.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250407044455/http://renai.us/game/theclown.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位未具名的女性叙述者。你突然在一间漆黑的房间里醒来，四处走动后，发现自己来到了一座马戏剧场。在那里，你将目睹可能是一生中最令人不安的场景之一。

（摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250407044455/http://renai.us/game/theclown.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
